title: Harbour building and boat

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Use a few distinctive forms to suggest place so the illustration remains readable at a smaller scale.
strategic_value: A harbor building, boat and people can evoke Helsinki’s maritime character without a dense collage.
demonstration: An ochre clock-tower building occupies the left; a pale-blue boat and gull sit right, with two people and vegetation below.
practical_value: Select a building-and-boat pairing when the maritime setting should remain the main cue.
